## Structure and components

- [statement] The required ttl document contains integer size and unit: ms, second, minute, hour, or day. Entries are evicted when TTL elapses. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-stream-processing/sp-agg-cachedlookup.md · keywords: Atlas Stream Processing cached lookup TTL and eviction

## How it works

- [statement] MongoDB recommends caching static or slowly changing reference data; its tier guide recommends higher tiers when large reference sets need more cache RAM. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-stream-processing/sp-agg-cachedlookup.md · keywords: Atlas Stream Processing cached lookup TTL and eviction · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-stream-processing/tier-guide.md, https://www.linkedin.com/posts/arundsharma_duckdb-activity-7269417756754665473-vOIl
- [statement] Inference: TTL is not a guaranteed residence time, because memory-pressure eviction can remove cached results earlier. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-stream-processing/sp-agg-cachedlookup.md · keywords: Atlas Stream Processing cached lookup TTL and eviction

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] At the memory limit, eviction frees space for new results. The syntax table describes older/expired results first, then random eviction if insufficient. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-stream-processing/sp-agg-cachedlookup.md · keywords: Atlas Stream Processing cached lookup TTL and eviction
- [statement] maxMemUsageBytes defaults to 10% of workspace RAM and cannot exceed 12.5%, according to the syntax table. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-stream-processing/sp-agg-cachedlookup.md · keywords: Atlas Stream Processing cached lookup TTL and eviction

## Facts and statements

- [statement] $cachedLookup joins stream messages to an Atlas collection registered in the Connection Registry and caches query results. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-stream-processing/sp-agg-cachedlookup.md · keywords: Atlas Stream Processing cached lookup TTL and eviction
- [statement] $cachedLookup does not support let or pipeline fields. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-stream-processing/sp-agg-cachedlookup.md · keywords: Atlas Stream Processing cached lookup TTL and eviction
- [statement] The 19 August 2025 release added $cachedLookup; the 27 August release added lifetime cache hit/miss statistics under stats.operatorStats. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-stream-processing/changelog.md · keywords: Atlas Stream Processing cached lookup TTL and eviction
